authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL sarpa gives Prakrit sappa, Lahnda/Punjabi sapp and explicitly Awankari sap “snake”. The survey sapʰ matches that short-vowel, retained-stop family; final release aspiration is preserved as recorded and does not motivate a distinct etymon. These are simple responses, without the material of the feminine sarpiṇī or young-snake derivatives.
